infotexts.talentdescription.betterman: Gain +15 Weapons skill and deal 15% more damage with ranged weapons.
infotexts.talentdescription.custommedhelmet: The Medical Helmet displays the medical status HUD while worn.
infotexts.talentdescription.customhealthinsurance: Get 20% off medical items. Complete a mission without losing any crew members to receive 300 marks.
infotexts.talentdescription.combatrage: When an ally is unconscious nearby, gain 25% firing rate, 15% damage, and 10% movement speed.
infotexts.talentdescription.customregen: Members of your crew are more resilient to minor injuries.
infotexts.talentdescription.customplantyield: When deconstructing plant products, you have a 30% chance to receive twice the materials.
infotexts.talentdescription.custommacrodosing: Buffs you apply last 50% longer. Deconstructing plant products yields +1 material. Also unlocks the Endocrine Booster recipe.
